abstract: A 32-year-old patient with unilateral beta hCG-positive seminoma and contralateral testicular intraepithelial neoplasia (TIN; so-called carcinoma-in-situ) with no metastases (clinical stage I) received one course of adjuvant carboplatin therapy. He refused further treatment of TIN in his remaining testis. His wife became pregnant by him 4 months later and delivered a healthy child at term. This case shows that patients with TIN in their remaining solitary testis are not necessarily infertile, and testes afflicted with TIN must also contain tubules that retain normal spermatogenic potential. Surveillance may be an treatment option for patients with TIN in their remaining testis in cases where there is a strong desire for paternity.
abstract_ja: 32歳の患者は、β-hCG陽性の片側精巣セミノーマと対側精巣上皮内腫瘍（TIN；いわゆる上皮内癌）を有していたが、転移はなく（臨床病期I）、補助療法として1コースのカルボプラチン療法を受けた。彼は残りの精巣に対するTINの治療を拒否した。4か月後に妻が妊娠し、健康な児を正期産で出産した。本症例は、残存する単独精巣にTINがあっても必ずしも不妊とは限らず、TINを有する精巣にも正常な精子形成能を保つ精細管が含まれうることを示している。父親になることを強く希望する場合、残存精巣にTINを有する患者では監視療法が治療選択肢となりうる。
